title: Emperor Chiu-Ai (Part Ix.--His Death and That of the Empress Jin-Go)

verses.t: Altogether the august years of this Heavenly Sovereign Tarashi-naka-tsu-hiko were fifty-two. His august mausoleum is at Nagaye, near Wega, in Kafuchi. (The Empress died at the august age of one hundred. She was buried in the mausoleum of Tatanami in Saki.)
